name: Combo: Column and Line
summary: Clustered columns with one or more line series, the lines optionally on a secondary value axis, for an amount beside a rate (revenue and margin %).

openxml.notes: One c:plotArea holds a c:barChart (clustered columns, primary axes) and a c:lineChart with markers. When chart.secondaryAxis is set, the secondary line series form a second c:lineChart on a second c:valAx (crosses max, at the right) and a deleted second c:catAx.
